abstract: Mammalian pregnancy has frequently been termed "Nature's allograft," and there is developing evidence that the placental trophoblast cells in their key position at the maternal fetal interface are responsible for escape mechanisms to the maternal immune system. In this paper, we show impaired susceptibility of human trophoblastic tumor cells to major histocompatibility complex (MHC) nonrestricted cytotoxicity systems such as natural killer (NK) cells and lymphokine-activated killer (LAK) cells. LAK cells were induced by the culture of peripheral blood mononuclear lymphocytes (PBL) in recombinant interleukin-2 (rIL-2). Among 21 cultured cell lines derived from various tissues and organs tested, five choriocarcinoma-derived cell lines gave decreased levels of LAK lysis. Cold-target inhibition study and trinitrophenyl (TNP) modification experiment clearly indicated that the impaired sensitivity of trophoblast cells to LAK lysis is due to the decrease of a common target molecule recognized by LAK effector cells. It is suggested that the impaired susceptibilty of trophoblast to MHC nonrestricted killer cells should be functional for the survival of the semiallogeneic fetus.
abstract_ja: 哺乳類の妊娠は「自然の同種移植」と呼ばれることがしばしばあり、母体免疫系からの回避機構を担う、母児境界面の栄養膜細胞の役割を示す証拠が増えている。本論文では、ヒト栄養膜腫瘍細胞の、NK細胞やLAK細胞などのMHC非拘束性細胞傷害系への感受性低下を示す。末梢血単核リンパ球(PBL)を組換えインターロイキン2で培養してLAK細胞を誘導した。様々な組織・臓器由来の培養細胞株21種を検査したところ、5種の絨毛癌由来細胞株でLAK溶解の低下が認められた。競合阻害実験とTNP修飾実験により、栄養膜細胞のLAK溶解に対する感受性低下は、LAKエフェクター細胞が認識する共通の標的分子の減少によることが明確に示された。栄養膜細胞がMHC非拘束性キラー細胞に感受性を示さないことは、半同種の胎児の生存に有利に働くと考えられる。
